claims.quote: The Queen began the morning in the small domestic orbit she had kept for herself at Windsor: a single room of pale curtains, a brass kettle, a row of shoes lined as if for inspection.

The butler arrived with the day's ledger and a quietled face. He moved as he always did through the apartment: a practised economy of gait, a carriage of small ceremonies. He laid the ledger on the table and, without being asked, set out the note of luncheon possibilities in his careful hand.
"One thing," she said, when the ledger had been read and the butler's voice had returned to its neutral cadence. "I should like a walk. The Long Walk, if you please."
"We will make provisions. I will keep the household flexible. The kitchen will put together something—sliced cold chicken, open sandwiches and fruit—should you return hungry.

The lady-in-waiting arrived shortly, efficient and luminous in the way of those who practiced stillness. She stood at the door and folded her hands in the old way; there was a steadiness to her expression that the Queen had learned to lean on. When the Queen said, plainly, "I would like a walk," the lady's fingers tightened for the briefest instant and then relaxed into her answer.
The Long Walk lay precisely as it always did in summer—an avenue of light and green that seemed at once public and private.

A gardener was there at the pavilion, sleeves rolled and straw hat low, attending to the beds of tea-roses. He lifted a hand by way of greeting; his presence was a piece of the castle's machinery, as much a part of the place as the stones. He did not come close enough to overhear.
"It is odd," she said, looking straight ahead, "how public everything feels even when one is alone."
"You do what is required of you," the lady said finally. "But you do not have to carry it as though there were only one shoulder convenient for it. There are hands that will hold it if you ask."
"The kitchen prepared a cold tray, as requested."
She opened the journal, though she did not write long. The day had already changed shape: the walk had cost her nothing public but it had also given her, quietly, an altered view of the day to come.
